nlp_spatial_evaluation.pipeline: agentic_osint_fusion: gazetteer(nlp) -> spatial decay -> consensus gate

evaluation_notes: Every scenario is resolved through the real backend gazetteer (resolve_sumatra_location_and_corridor) and structured extractor (_fast_heuristic_extraction); the Haversine error between the resolved node and the ground-truth coordinate drives the gate's exponential spatial decay (e^(-d/25 km), d capped at 10 km beyond which a mention is regency-scale). Detection and Brier/ECE are scored on the calibrated forecast: the consensus probability normalized by P_max = 1 - prod(1 - w_k) of the declared W 0.35 / T 0.25 / I 0.20 / E 0.20 weight profile (P_max = 0.688). The un-normalized product P = 1 - prod(1 - w_k * p_k) is structurally capped at P_max, so scoring it directly biases every forecast low (raw product Brier is reported separately as raw_brier_score). LLM structured extraction (opencode driver model, default deepseek-v4.1-flash) is cached in data/benchmark/llm_extraction_cache.json; latency_ms measures the warm inference path (state build + consensus gate + decision) per scenario.

scenario_details.headline: Distribusi Logistik Energi dan Bahan Pokok di Kawasan Industri Lhokseumawe Berjalan Terjadwal
scenario_details.case_notes: Distribusi energi dan bahan pokok normal tanpa kendala.

scenario_details.name: Banjir Luapan Sungai Soraya Aceh Singkil
scenario_details.source_reference: Laporan BPBD Aceh Singkil / Antara Aceh, 8 Nov 2023
scenario_details.headline: Sungai Soraya Meluap Rendam Badan Jalan Penghubung ke Aceh Singkil, Angkutan Sembako Terisolasi

scenario_details.name: Longsor Perbukitan Bireuen-Takengon Enang-Enang
scenario_details.source_reference: Laporan BPBD Bireuen / Antara Aceh, 19 Mar 2024
scenario_details.headline: Longsor Material Bebatuan Tutup Jalur Bireuen-Takengon di Enang-Enang, Pasokan Kopi Gayo Terhambat
scenario_details.case_notes: Longsor bebatuan menutup jalur Enang-Enang 8,5 jam; kopi Gayo tertahan menuju pesisir.

scenario_details.name: Isu Kelangkaan BBM Subulussalam Dipastikan Hoaks
scenario_details.source_reference: Klarifikasi Pertamina / Antara Aceh, 29 Mei 2024

scenario_details.case_notes: Stok BBM 12 hari dan tidak ada antrean; isu kelangkaan dinyatakan hoaks.

scenario_details.name: Abrasi & Amblas Jalur Lintas Barat Bengkulu-Krui

scenario_details.case_notes: Abrasi menggerus setengah badan Jalinbar KM 42 selama 11,5 jam; truk muatan dilarang melintas.

scenario_details.name: Longsor Tebing Pegunungan Kepahiang-Bengkulu

scenario_details.case_notes: Buka tutup 8 jam di Liku Sembilan; distribusi Bengkulu-Curup tertahan.

scenario_details.name: Pengerukan Alur Pelabuhan Pulau Baai Berjalan Normal

scenario_details.case_notes: Alur pelayaran aman; kapal sembako dan CPO bersandar sesuai jadwal.

scenario_details.name: Banjir Luapan Sungai Air Manjunto Mukomuko

scenario_details.case_notes: Luapan menutup Jalinbar 6,5 jam; truk CPO tertahan menuju Padang.

scenario_details.case_notes: Peringatan angin kencang bersifat pesisir; arus logistik darat tetap lancar.

scenario_details.name: Longsor Tebing Rimbo Pengadang Lebong

scenario_details.case_notes: Longsor menutup akses Curup-Lebong 8,5 jam; beras tidak bisa masuk Lebong.

scenario_details.case_notes: Pemeriksaan rutin tanpa penahanan berarti; arus logistik perbatasan tertib.
